notes.title: Phoenix 2 turned 9! 🥳🚀
notes.content:
[p]Released in July 2016 and still going strong, with ongoing content updates and an amazing, active community 🥰 Be sure to salute players with the 9-year-veteran badge, they've been blasting invaders from the very beginning, they are the best 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate our beloved arcade shoot'em up, we are giving away a VIP Week Pass here on Steam, as well as on X, Reddit and Discord![/p][p][/p][p]Comment below during this weekend (August 1, 2, 3) to participate. We will randomly draw a winner on Sunday evening CET.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep on charging those Warp Gates, we have an exciting year ahead of us!
🐦‍🔥Ⅱ[/p]

notes.title: Phoenix 2 Update 7.3
notes.content:
This update brings several additional benefits for VIP members, as well as a slew of improvements and fixes.

[list]
[*] A daily [b]VIP Mission[/b] has been added. These missions are exclusive for VIP members and are played with a different [b]Apex form[/b] each day.
[*] Additional items are available from the Warp Gate for VIP members.
[*] Numerous fixes and improvements for everybody.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates that are on the way!

notes.title: Play Phoenix 2 Now!
notes.content:
Phoenix 2 is available to play [b]right now[/b]!

We are super excited to bring Phoenix 2 to PC, give it a try and let us know what you think.

Phoenix 2 features:
[list]
[*] A [b]complete 30-mission campaign[/b]. Accessible missions to familiarize with the game while gradually increasing the challenge.
[*] [b] 3 new Daily Missions[/b] every day, including a specialist mission for higher ranks with additional requirements.
[*] Community missions available every 3 days. [b]Create[/b] your own or [b]join[/b] an existing community, each with its [b]own unique missions[/b].
[*] [b]100 unique ships[/b], each with 6 upgrade levels for their [b]Weapons, Aura, and Zen abilities[/b], plus [b]2 Apex Forms[/b] featuring unique visuals and an [b]Apex ability[/b].
[*] [b]Full cross-save and cross-play support.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Phoenix 2 releases March 7
notes.content:
Phoenix 2 is dodging bullets, destroying invaders and blazing towards its Early Access release date of March 7!

We are super excited about bringing Phoenix 2 to PC, and we cannot wait for everybody to give it a try.

Be sure to [b]add Phoenix 2 to your wishlist[/b] to receive a notification [b]the moment it becomes available![/b]

A quick recap of the game features:
[list]
[*] The popular mobile game adapted for PC!
[*] Blast invaders with over 100 unique ships.
[*] Build your own ship collection and upgrade your favorites.
[*] Experience an action packed campaign with 30 exciting story missions.
[*] Discover special abilities like Mega Laser, Missile Swarm and Personal Shield.
[*] Complete missions of different skill levels, from casual to bullet hell.
[*] Get the high score on global leaderboards and show you are the best of the best.
[*] Engage with an active community to help each other and discuss ship tactics.
[*] Create a group for your friends and play your own unique missions.
[*] Excellent Mouse, Controller and Keyboard controls, try them all!
[*] Log into your Firi account to load your existing progress, cross-save, cross-play, cross everything!
[/list]

🚀 See you on the 7th! 🚀

-Firi Games

notes.title: Phoenix 2 will be available via Early Access!
notes.content:
We have focused on the PC update of Phoenix 2 for the past 6 months. After 2 weeks of closed beta testing, it is finally ready for a public release via Early Access.

We are super excited about bringing Phoenix 2 to PC, and we cannot wait for everybody to give it a try.

Be sure to [b]add Phoenix 2 to your wishlist[/b] to receive a notification [b]the moment it becomes available![/b]

Some quick information:
[list]
[*] The gameplay and functionality is the same as on mobile, plus a bit more!
[*] The same free to play pricing.
[*] Excellent Mouse, Controller and Keyboard controls, try them all!
[*] Leaderboards are cross platform
[*] Log into your Firi account to load your progress, cross-save, cross everything!
[*] Enjoy gorgeous full screen Starmap graphics.
[*] View cool extra stats while playing missions.
[/list]

🚀 See you on March 7! 🚀

-Firi Games
